WITH overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(budget.remaining) as overall_remaining
  FROM budget
),
event_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    budget.link_to_event,
    AVG(budget.spent) as avg_spent,
    AVG(budget.remaining) as avg_remaining
  FROM budget
  GROUP BY budget.link_to_event
)
SELECT 
  event_stats.link_to_event,
  event_stats.avg_spent,
  event_stats.avg_remaining,
  event_stats.avg_remaining - overall_avg.overall_remaining as difference_from_overall_avg
FROM event_stats
CROSS JOIN overall_avg
ORDER BY difference_from_overall_avg DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10
